 Predictions and form stats 
 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 19th Match - Melbourne Stars Women vs Brisbane Heat Women and 20th Match - Melbourne Renegades Women vs Sydney Sixers Women, to be played on the 12th of November at the Junction Oval, Melbourne.
 Match Prediction - Melbourne Stars Women v Brisbane Heat Women 
 LIVE SCORES - 19th Match - Melbourne Stars Women vs Brisbane Heat Women (Junction Oval, Melbourne) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 146
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 133
 Current Form Melbourne Stars Women: 
 Melbourne Stars Women are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 1 win and 4 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.611.
 The top run scorer for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Annabel Sutherland with 122 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Annabel Sutherland with 6 scalps under her belt .
 Melbourne Stars Women have lost their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by 6 wickets .
 Melbourne Stars Women batted first and they posted a total of 136 for 6 in 20 overs. Meg Lanning and Rhys McKenna started off very well, stitching a partnership of 38 runs for the 1st wicket. However the runs came at a very low pace and it didn't help the team much. McKenna made 12 runs while Lanning went on to score 56 runs in 46 deliveries. The rest of the batters disappointed and couldn't make any impact on the game. Georgia Prestwidge scored 23 quick runs in the lower order to help Melbourne Stars Women get past the 130 run mark, as they finished at 136 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Perth Scorchers Women lost the key wicket of Katie Mack quite early. After her dismissal, Beth Mooney and Sophie Devine got together to form a partnership of 72 runs to seal the deal in favor of Perth Scorchers Women. Sophie Devine went on to score 55 runs in only 24 balls. Mikayla Hinkley and Chloe Piparo also contributed healthily and Perth Scorchers Women got over the line in the 15th over itself with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Brisbane Heat Women: 
 Brisbane Heat Women are currently placed at the 4th position on points table with 2 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.020.
 The top run scorer for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Charli Knott with 183 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Lily Bassingthwaighte with 5 scalps under her belt .
 Brisbane Heat Women have won their previous match against Hobart Hurricanes Women by 4 wickets .
 Hobart Hurricanes Women batted first and they posted a total of 116 for 9 in 20 overs. Lizelle Lee, Kate Pelle and Chamari Athapaththu got out without troubling the scorers much. Rachel Trenaman and Maddy Green tried their best to infuse life into the game. Trenaman made 25 runs while Green scored 24 but both of them got out at a very wrong time. After that, Hobart Hurricanes Women failed to rise up at all and they were restricted to an under par total of 116 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Brisbane Heat Women lost the key wicket of Charli Knott quite early. After her dismissal, Grace Harris and Yastika Bhatia moved the innings forward with knocks of 24 and 22 runs respectively. A couple of wickets fell in quick succession and there were few hiccups in middle overs but Annie O'Neil had their back. She smashed 32 runs off 28 balls, stayed not out and helped Brisbane Heat Women get over the line in the 19th over itself with 4 wickets in hand.

 Match Prediction - Melbourne Renegades Women v Sydney Sixers Women 
 LIVE SCORES - 20th Match - Melbourne Renegades Women vs Sydney Sixers Women (Junction Oval, Melbourne) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 146
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 133
 Current Form Melbourne Renegades Women: 
 Melbourne Renegades Women are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.55.
 The top run scorer for Melbourne Renegades Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Wareham with 175 runs to her name .
 The top wicket taker for Melbourne Renegades Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Tayla Vlaeminck with 5 scalps under her belt.
 Melbourne Renegades Women have won their previous match against Adelaide Strikers Women by a big margin of 36 runs .
 Melbourne Renegades Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 188 for 3 in 20 overs. Olivia Porter got out without troubling the scorers much. After her dismissal, Hayley Matthews and Courtney Webb played really well. Matthews made 49 while Webb scored 52 runs. A real match winning innings came from Georgia Wareham's bat. She smashed 73 runs off only 31 balls as Melbourne Renegades Women managed to reach a tall total of 188 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Emma de Broughe and Maia Bouchier started off very well with them adding 67 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Once the first wicket fell, it triggered a frequent fall of wickets. Tayla Vlaeminck picked up 2 wickets while Milly Illingworth accounted for 3 scalps to shake things up for Adelaide Strikers Women. There was no real effort shown by the lower order too and Adelaide Strikers Women were restricted to 152 for 8 in 20 overs, losing the match by 36 runs.
 Current Form Sydney Sixers Women: 
 Sydney Sixers Women are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 4 wins to their credit. They have 8 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.316.
 The top run scorer for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Ashleigh Gardner with 224 runs to her name .
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Ashleigh Gardner with 8 scalps under her belt.
 Sydney Sixers Women have won their previous match against Sydney Thunder Women by just 9 runs .
 The match was reduced to 16 overs per side due to rain.
 Sydney Sixers Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 162 for 2 in 16 overs. Ellyse Perry was simply sensational at the top. She scored 59 off only 41 deliveries, collecting 11 boundaries. Amelia Kerr and Sophia Dunkley disappointed while Ashleigh Gardner looked at her best. She smashed 64 runs off only 25 deliveries, hitting 5 fours and 5 sixes. On the back of her acceleration towards the back end, Sydney Sixers Women managed to get to a tall total of 162 in 16 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sydney Thunder Women lost their premier batters Georgia Voll and Phoebe Litchfield quite early into the innings. Anika Learoyd and Heather Knight also failed to contribute and Sydney Thunder Women looked in all sorts of bother. Laura Harris and Nadine de Klerk fought very hard. Harris smashed 35 off only 10 balls but she got out at a wrong time. After her dismissal, Sydney Thunder Women slowed down and they were eventually bowled out for 158, losing the match by 9 runs.
